hero.title:

current.title: Current (Apply Now Only)
current.employees: Employee hiring {strong}not required{/strong} (can be substituted with capital)

new.title: After Amendment (From October)
new.capital: Capital {strong}30 million yen or more mandatory{/strong}

reasons.title: Significant Capital Requirement Increase
reasons.description: Capital requirement increased {strong}6 times{/strong} (5 million → 30 million yen).

reasons.title: Mandatory Full-time Employment
reasons.description: After amendment, {strong}full-time employment of 1+ persons{/strong} is mandatory, significantly raising application barriers at startup preparation stage.

reasons.title: Added Degree or Management Experience Requirements
reasons.description: Manager must have {strong}degree{/strong} (PhD/Master/Professional) or {strong}3+ years management experience{/strong}, potentially disqualifying many applicants.

reasons.title: Professional Involvement in Business Plan
reasons.description: Business plan evaluation by {strong}Small and Medium Enterprise Management Consultants{/strong} required, leading to significant cost increases.

services.title: Same-day Diagnosis
services.description: Online consultation to thoroughly examine your situation. Same-day determination of current requirement eligibility, shortest route, and required documents.

services.title: Comprehensive Document and Plan Creation
services.description: Capital payment certificates, resume/career history, 4-month business plan drafted and finalized through intensive short-term work.

services.title: Thorough Progress Management
services.description: Through thorough progress management, we {strong}achieve September application{/strong}.

checklist.title: Checklist to Meet Current Requirements
items: Secured {strong}5 million yen{/strong} capital payment funds
Can prepare {strong}fund certificates{/strong} such as bank payment/balance certificates
Can articulate business ideas, market, and initial transaction prospects

pricing.title: Fees
includes: Included: Requirement diagnosis, complete document creation, process management, submission proxy, correction support
Not included: Government fees, actual costs (balance certificates, registration matters, etc.), postage, translation fees
Payment timing: Initial payment at contract, remaining balance before submission (negotiable)
Fees may include difficulty surcharge. We provide estimates before contract
pricing.note: ※Language support is Japanese only. Overseas residents should consider having a Japanese-speaking agent present.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

questions.question: Is an office required for 4-month visa?
questions.answer: No. For provisional residence for business preparation, application is possible without office contract (current requirements).

questions.question: Is it possible to meet the deadline?
questions.answer: Possible if documents are ready. Please consult by {strong}9/14 (Sun) 23:59{/strong} (limited to 3 companies).

questions.question: What happens after 4 months?
questions.answer: We proceed with office contract and system preparation, leading to 1-year renewal. We accompany you from immediately after acquisition.

questions.question: About language support
questions.answer: Zoom consultation is in Japanese. Overseas residents should consider having a Japanese-speaking agent present.

faq.disclaimer: ※Laws and practices may change without notice. Please consult individually for latest information.
